Question: How can high-entropy alloys (HEAs) be designed to simultaneously achieve high fracture strength and high ductility while overcoming issues of inferior castability and compositional segregation?. System: AlCoCrFeNi 2.1 (atomic portion) eutectic high-entropy alloy (EHEA). Processing: Vacuum induction melting of commercially pure elements (Al, Co, Ni: 99.9 wt.%; Cr, Fe: 99.5 ~ 99.6 wt.%) in a BN crucible; heating to 600°C for 1 hour; pouring at 1500°C into a MgO crucible (220 mm length, 62 mm upper ID, 50 mm bottom ID) under argon atmosphere (0.06 MPa); subsequent cold rolling with 8% thickness reduction for some specimens.. Test conditions: Room temperature tensile tests at strain rate 1 × 10⁻³ s⁻¹ (Instron 5569); high-temperature tensile tests at 600°C and 700°C at strain rate 1 × 10⁻³ s⁻¹ (Gleeble 3500); cold rolled specimens tested at room temperature at strain rate 2 × 10⁻³ s⁻¹.. Paper card. Question: Can high-entropy alloys be designed to simultaneously achieve high Snoek-type damping capacity, high mechanical strength, and high ductility at elevated temperatures?. System: Ta0.5Nb0.5HfZrTi base HEA, (Ta0.5Nb0.5HfZrTi)98O2 (O-2 HEA), and (Ta0.5Nb0.5HfZrTi)98N2 (N-2 HEA). Processing: Arc-melting of pure metals (purity >99.9 wt%), TiN (99.9 wt%), and TiO2 (99.9 wt%) in a Ti-gettered high-purity argon atmosphere; remelted at least eight times; drop-cast into a water-cooled copper mold (10 mm × 10 mm × 60 mm). Test conditions: Damping measured via multifunction internal friction apparatus at 0.5, 1.0, 2.0, and 4.0 Hz, temperature range 300–1100 K, heating rate 2 K min⁻¹, max strain amplitude 2 × 10⁻⁴; Tensile tests at room temperature, strain rate 1 × 10⁻³ s⁻¹. Question: How do small additions of hafnium (0.5 at.%) and molybdenum (1.0 at.) to the base high-entropy alloy Al 10 Co 25 Cr 8 Fe 15 Ni 36 Ti 6 affect microstructural characteristics and high-temperature mechanical properties, and can directional solidification further optimize these properties?. System: Al 10 Co 25 Cr 8 Fe 15 Ni 36 Ti 6 (base), Al 9 Co 25 Cr 8 Fe 15 Ni 36 Ti 6 Mo 1 (Mo-added), Al 9.5 Co 25 Cr 8 Fe 15 Ni 36 Ti 6 Hf 0.5 (Hf-added).
